summary: Adobe's creative portfolio network — professional reputation and hiring credential use case remains sticky despite AI image tools.
moat: Behance's moat is its role as the professional identity layer for creative industries: designers, illustrators, and photographers maintain portfolios that serve as hiring credentials and client proof-of-work. Adobe's integration with Creative Cloud embeds Behance in the workflow of 33 million Creative Cloud subscribers. Professional creative reputation accumulated over years cannot be faked by AI without undermining its purpose.

challengers.name: Adobe Firefly AI image generation
challengers.evidence: Adobe Firefly generated over 9 billion AI images in its first year, raising questions about whether AI-assisted work displaces the showcase value of traditional human design portfolios on Behance.
